channel.title: The Cannabis Community - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Cannabis Community (thecannabiscommunity.org)

item.title: Schedule III Executive Order: What It Means for Medical Cannabis Patients
item.description: Trump’s Schedule III executive order doesn’t make dispensary cannabis federally legal. Learn what changes, what doesn’t, and what patients should do next.

item.title: Vape Heating Element Performance: Why Hardware Matters
item.description: Your vape experience depends on the heating element. Learn why flavor, clogs, and consistency come down to heat, and what to look for.

item.title: Cotton Wick Cartridges: Pros, Cons, and Burnt Hits
item.description: Cotton wick carts can work great or taste burnt fast. Learn why burnt hits happen, when cotton makes sense, and how to avoid issues.

item.title: Quartz Rod Coils: Fast Heat, Big Tradeoffs
item.description: Quartz rod coils heat fast and hit hard, but come with tradeoffs. Learn why they feel intense, why they’re niche now, and what to expect.
